subject: Retention exception request + subprocessor delegation - MedSquare
messages:
From: Sophie Laurent <sophie.laurent@medsquare.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medsquare.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Short-term retention exception + subprocessor delegation request

Hi Avery / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the integration looks promising. Two asks from our legal/ops side as we prepare to pilot:

1) Retention exception: We need a documented short-term exception to retain a small subset of EU patient identifiers (hashed ID + timestamp) for up to 30 days for debugging and audit trails during the initial 3-week pilot. Our DPA retention schedule otherwise requires 14 days; legal is asking for a temporary deviation with controls (access limited to named engineers, audit log enabled). I attached a completed retention-exception-form.pdf with the fields filled.

2) Subprocessor delegation: We plan to route telemetry for analytics through our on-prem analytics partner (OnSiteMetrics). We need confirmation that Redwood will: (a) permit the specific subprocessor, (b) accept a delegation flow for that partner, and (c) provide an up-to-date subprocessor CSV for our procurement team. I included a proposed delegation.csv in the attachment with the partner details.

Timing: procurement is hoping to close the pilot contract by Nov 24. Can you confirm next steps and whether Redwood needs an amended DPA or an addendum for the 30-day retention exception? cc'd procurement.

Attachments: retention-exception-form.pdf; subprocessor-delegation-proposal.csv

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Laurent
Head of Legal Ops, MedSquare Health
Sophie.Laurent@medsquare.com
+44 20 7946 0921
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Laurent <sophie.laurent@medsquare.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Short-term retention exception + subprocessor delegation request

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear note and attachments.

Short answer: we can support a scoped 30-day exception for a pilot with the controls you outlined, and we can accept OnSiteMetrics as a subprocessor pending our onboarding checklist. A few clarifying items before we confirm in writing:

- Scope: please confirm the exact fields that will be retained (you mentioned hashed ID + timestamp only). No PII or raw identifiers, correct?
- Access list: please provide the named engineers who should have access during the pilot so we can scope ACLs and audit filters.
- Audit cadence: we'll enable token-level audit logs and retain a copy for 90 days internally; will MedSquare want a copy of log extracts or just confirmation that logs exist?

Next steps from our side: Kimberly in Legal will prepare a short addendum to the existing DPA that (a) documents the 30-day exception, and (b) records the specific subprocessor approval workflow for OnSiteMetrics. I will schedule a 30-minute sync tomorrow to align on the remaining fields and procurement cadence.

Proposed times: Tue 17 Nov 10:00-10:30 PT or 15:00-15:30 PT. Let me know which works.

Thanks — we'll push a draft dpa addendum and the subprocessor CSV by EOD tomorrow.

— Avery
Avery Johnson
Director, Solutions (Americas) | Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Sophie Laurent <sophie.laurent@medsquare.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@medsquare.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 07:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Short-term retention exception + subprocessor delegation request

Hi all — looping in a short legal note ahead of the sync.

1) Retention exception: We can draft a two-paragraph addendum to the DPA that: (i) narrowly limits retained elements to the hashed identifier and event timestamp, (ii) defines the 30-day retention window for pilot records only, and (iii) requires documented approval of named MedSquare engineers for access. We will also require that MedSquare confirms in writing that no downstream processors will request the raw identifier.

2) Subprocessor (OnSiteMetrics): We can conditionally approve OnSiteMetrics provided they complete our subprocessor onboarding questionnaire and sign our standard subprocessor agreement. We can expedite an interim delegation that permits limited telemetry transfer for the pilot if OnSiteMetrics agrees to read-only telemetry and SOC 2 Type II attestation evidence.

I attached a draft addendum (medsquare-dpa-draft-v2.docx) with tracked language for the retention clause and a short subprocessor approval template. Please review before the sync; we'll aim to have a clean version ready for signature via DocuSign after any redlines.

Attachments: medsquare-dpa-draft-v2.docx

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Laurent <sophie.laurent@medsquare.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medsquare.com>, Harrison & Co. <contracts@harrisonco.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Short-term retention exception + subprocessor delegation request

Thank you — this is helpful. Quick responses after internal review:

- Scope confirmed: hashed patient_id + event_timestamp only, no raw identifiers.
- Access list: attaching a short CSV with the three engineers who will have access during the pilot (engineers-access-list.csv).
- Logs: procurement is happy with confirmation and sample log extract on request; we'll request extracts only if an issue is flagged.

OnSiteMetrics has agreed to complete Redwood's onboarding questionnaire; procurement asked whether the interim delegation can be in place before the full subprocessor agreement is executed to avoid blocking the pilot kickoff. If Redwood is comfortable with an interim delegation that limits processing to read-only telemetry + SOC 2 evidence to be provided within 7 business days, procurement will proceed to finalize payment terms.

Next: Sophie to sign the addendum after a quick legal pass from Harrison & Co. and procurement to initiate DocuSign once Kimberly shares the final clean version. Can Kimberly confirm ETA for the clean addendum?

Thanks again — aiming to kick pilot week of Nov 29.

Best,
Sophie

OnSite attachment references: engineers-access-list.csv (attached), procurement asked for final DocuSign link when available.
